title: FBI-UAP-D007, FD-1057-06, Northeastern United States, 2024
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-1057 form detailing UAP surveillance conducted by two special agents in November 2024; the text contains significant redactions of names and specific locations.

incidents.summary: FBI agents observed a white pulsating light moving erratically at or below the tree line near a pond.
incidents.quote: The white light danced around less than ten seconds, moving side to side, and then disappeared.

incidents.summary: FBI agents observed white lights appearing at the tree line that pulsed with a white/blue hue, and plumes of light followed by red or white flashes.
incidents.quote: These lights would pulse and flash it white/blue hue and then disappear.

incidents.summary: FBI agents observed a bright white light above a bright red light hovering at tree-top height, moving quickly from right to left, disappearing, and reappearing.
incidents.quote: The UAP appeared as a bright white light above a bright red light at the far end of the pond hovered at a approximately tree-top height
